profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with 15+ years of experience specializing in frontend development - currently utilizing React and Redux to develop single page applications. I am very fortunate to be able to collaborate with great teammates across a variety of different industries and fields, see technology evolve since the 90s,  and overall extraordinarily grateful to be in a field that allows for constant growth and creativity.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Utilizing ReactJS to develop Workday’s cloud-based collaborative products – Drive (File management service that enables user to store, access, and share files online), Worksheets (a cloud-based, real-time collaborative spreadsheet built directly into the core of Workday’s technology platform), and Slides (application to create presentations and slides that also integrates with Worksheets data). 

• Developed spreadsheet features for Worksheets such as formula editing, conditional formatting, pivot tables, drag and drop, and edit live data for spreadsheet application. 
• Provided technical expertise and strategy to help drive decisions around accessibility, keyboard handling, state management, testing philosophies, and dependency management. 
• Provided mentorship and guidance for teammates and new developers while working within an Agile environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Worked with leadership, management, and other engineers to provide technical strategy; Developed new applications using a mix of Angular, ReactJS, and Python while also supporting legacy codebase.

• Provided technical expertise and strategy to help drive architectural decisions and other technical priorities.
• Provided mentorship and guidance for teammates and new developers.
• Developed data access and mapping application to discover and download geospatial data using Angular 10, GeoServer, and OpenLayers.
• Developed visualization tools and REST API for data processing, data access and analysis using ReactJS and Python.
• Developed new scripts and refactored legacy code and web-services to Python 3 in order to streamline GPS/GNSS dataflow process.

positions.title: Software Engineer III, Front-End
positions.description:
Developed websites and applications to support organization's Geodesy needs for projects funded through NSF and NASA.

• Rebuilt and redesigned EarthScope.org with updated UX/UI and workflow using ExpressionEngine CMS.
• Developed front-end mapping application for Earthscope.org using KnockoutJS and Google Maps API.
• Developed internal analytics and network monitoring suite to measure network data usage and health using AngularJS, Google Maps API, and HighCharts.
• Migrated, consolidated, and refactored legacy code for network monitoring pages to streamline workflow and increase maintainability.

positions.title: Head Of Digital
positions.description:
Worked alongside a dedicated team of public relations personnel to develop strategies and digital marketing plans for clients through marketing research, analytics, and best practices.

•	Developed multiple websites and digital solutions for businesses spanning multiple industries - medical, technological, sports, nutrition, and entertainment industries.
•	Developed e-commerce integration solutions via PayPal, Stripe, and BigCommerce platforms.
•	Created and optimized SEO campaigns in Google Adwords and Microsoft Adcenter.
•	Developed effective business strategies and digital deployment for vendors and clients.

positions.title: Manager of Web Development
positions.description:
Oversaw and led the organization’s digital strategy with focus on fan engagement and revenue generation. Managed a team of developers and designers to administer the organization’s websites, social media platforms, mobile applications, content management systems, and customer relationships management systems.

•	Managed the development and design of Buccaneers.com, mobile application, CMS, and CRM.
•	Researched multiple venues and applications in order to improve overall fan engagement on the website, mobile, and social media platforms.
•	Documented best practices for user interface design and information architecture.
•	Led the initiative for research and development of digital tools to improve workflow and lower operating costs.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained Buccaneers.com, GlazerFamilyFoundation.com, company’s intranet, and various satellite sites.

•	Administered social media for the organization via Message Boards, Facebook, and Twitter.
•	Setup press conferences coverage for live streaming using Adobe Media Server, Wirecast, and LiveStream.
•	Provided data analysis and marketing research by the use of Omniture and Google Analytics.
•	Facilitated the needs of clients/partners in terms of required web assets such as videos, graphics, RSS feeds, etc.

positions.title: Flash Developer
positions.description:
Developed interactive applications for clients using Adobe Flash, HTML, and CSS. (Clients included Hasbro, Alienware, Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile)

•	Developed interactive applications, product demos, and websites for clients using Adobe Flash and Adobe Photoshop.
•	Developed company’s intranet using Microsoft Small Business Server, ISA, SQL Server, and SharePoint.
•	Maintained company’s intranet and extranet, analytics reporting applications, and systems’ infrastructure.
• 	Utilized Adobe Photoshop for image editing and correction.
